audience: accounts receivable teams that run credit control for Xero or QuickBooks with Paidnice

useCases.title: List invoices overdue by more than 30 days
useCases.text: List unpaid or overdue invoices, earliest due date first. Filter by due date range. Open one invoice for its amounts and contact.

useCases.title: Find which reminders failed and why
useCases.text: List reminders, late fees and statements with their status and any error. Check which credit control policies run for a contact and why.

useCases.title: Read customer replies about invoices
useCases.text: List email and SMS replies from customers, newest first. Each reply shows the matched contact when Paidnice found one.

useCases.title: Check Stripe payments and collection notes
useCases.text: List payments taken through Stripe on the customer portal, with the invoices each one paid. List collection notes for a contact or an invoice.

useCases.title: Assign a contact to a team member
useCases.text: List the team members, then assign a contact to one of them, or unassign it. Only the contact changes, not its invoices.

useCases.title: Assign an invoice and notify its owner
useCases.text: List the team members, then assign an invoice to one of them. The team member is notified, as when assigning in the app.
